detail: Disabling pass-1 re-pricing leaves dist per-pipe-relaxed (wide member still gives dist[m1]=5) while pass-2 equality uses first-seen 20: m1 5+20=25≠10, m2 20≠10 → count 0, route vanishes. PR-body toggle output confirms count 0 — no flip to m2.
recommended_fix: Reword the comment: with re-pricing disabled the (res,host) next-hop set becomes EMPTY (count 0) — pass-2 equality matches neither m1 (5+20=25≠10) nor m2 (10+10=20≠10) — not a flip to m2.
